file: CWE-117-loop-counter-safe.py

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger("app")


def run(count: int) -> None:
    for i in range(count):
        logger.info(f"Performance test message {i + 1}")
    for component in ["auth.service", "db.connection", "cache.redis"]:
        logger.info(f"{component} initialized successfully")
